chain_words.nuance: any small increase in money or advantage
money received from work or business activity
money left after all costs are paid
a share of profit paid to shareholders
a sudden, very large and unexpected amount of profit

explanation: These words all express money gained from business, from a small gain to a sudden, very large amount.

usage_notes.difference: 'Earnings' is the total money received, often before costs are removed; 'profit' is what remains after all costs are paid.
